row.evidence: Pylon's docs say SCIM appears in Access & SSO settings only 'Once SAML is enabled', and list 'SAML SSO (Enterprise-only)'; usepylon.com/pricing redirects to a demo-booking form, so SCIM is only available on the sales-quoted Enterprise plan.
row.notes: Quote-only: usepylon.com/pricing redirects to 'Schedule a personalized 30-minute demo' and no public plan prices exist. SCIM is set up under Settings > Access & SSO after SAML is enabled, and SAML is Enterprise-only, so the SCIM plan is Enterprise by prerequisite. Docs describe provisioning and deprovisioning and role mapping under Provisioning, but publish no SCIM base URL, attributes or per-IdP guides; Google and Microsoft sign-in are available outside Enterprise but are not SAML. No Pylon app found in Okta's catalogue or Entra's tutorial list. The public REST API (bearer token, admin-created) lists, gets, searches and updates users (name, role_id, status) and lists user roles and audit logs; it has no create or deactivate endpoint.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.price_text: Contact Sales (pricing page redirects to demo booking)
plans.notes: Only tier named in public docs; other tiers are not published.

roles.how: Roles configured under Provisioning in Access & SSO settings

scim.notes: Plan inferred from the SAML prerequisite (SAML SSO is Enterprise-only). Version, base URL, auth, endpoints and attributes are not published.

auth.notes: Admin-created API token sent as a Bearer token.

endpoints.purpose: Get a user by its ID
Update a user (name, avatar_url, role_id, status)
Search for users by a given filter
Get a list of all user roles
Get a list of audit logs

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhooks fire from configurable Triggers; user lifecycle events are not listed.

rate_limits.text: GET /users and GET /users/{id}: 300 requests per minute; PATCH /users/{id}: 120 requests per minute

limitations.text: User objects expose is_deactivated, but no endpoint creates or deactivates users.

user_api.notes: EU region base URL https://api.eu.usepylon.com. Plan availability of the API is not stated.

okta.notes: No OIN page found at okta.com/integrations/pylon/ (and several slug variants).

entra.notes: No Pylon entry in the Entra saas-apps tutorial list (toc.json).

fallbacks.notes: Users are otherwise invited from the Users page with a role.

open_questions: SCIM base URL, token handling, supported attributes and group push are not documented publicly.
Whether SCIM deprovisioning deactivates or deletes the user, and whether it frees the seat, is not stated.
Which IdPs are supported for SCIM (docs name Okta, Azure AD and Google Workspace for SAML only).
Whether API access is limited to certain plans is not stated.
